readiness.reason: F-001 is a confirmed static defect on the core playlist flow. A failed load becomes an empty playlist marked saved (playlist.ts:81-93), and the error alert never fires because AuthFetchError has no status. Saving afterwards can overwrite the real day's list, which threatens on-air continuity. No runtime or browser verification exists.

F-001.reason: playlist.ts:83 reads e.status, which is always undefined, so no alert shows. playlist.ts:91 markSaved() runs unconditionally. Adding clips to the falsely empty list and saving can overwrite the real playlist.

F-002.reason: Token-refresh logic belongs to the backend and auth reviewers. I did not trace auth.ts:235-248.

F-003.reason: No component moves, traps or restores focus. ScheduleDialog and LiveDialog have no Escape handler. I think the severity is HIGH, but I dispute is_blocker.

F-004.reason: App.vue:83-88 updates html lang via useHead at runtime, and index.html:2 is only the pre-hydration default. I would treat it as at most a LOW casing nit.

F-005.reason: A hard-coded low-contrast colour on destructive buttons is plausible and consistent with the visual reviewer's evidence. I would rate it MEDIUM, not HIGH.

F-006.reason: Visual styling outside my scope. I did not check SettingsBreaks.

F-007.reason: auth.ts:324-327 checks e.status, which AuthFetchError never sets. A failed uuid fetch leaves the status stream dead with no visible error.

F-010.reason: The getPlaylist flow in playlist.ts has no request guard, so a stale response can overwrite state and the save snapshot. It shares a root cause with F-001.

F-011.reason: Not reviewed in my scope; I did not read media.ts.

F-013.reason: Locale completeness is not in my scope and I did not verify the key counts.

F-014.reason: There is no onBeforeRouteLeave or onBeforeRouteUpdate anywhere in src. Only beforeunload guards exist (PlaylistPanel.vue:234, App.vue:22). Actual data loss on route change is NOT_VERIFIED.

F-015.reason: Accessibility live-region claim outside my scope.

F-016.reason: Accessible-name inference is outside my scope.

F-018.reason: Contrast measurement is outside my scope.

F-019.reason: Theme token usage is outside my scope.

F-020.reason: Layout at narrow width is NOT_VERIFIED. I did not check PlaylistPanel.vue:1355.

F-023.reason: This is security-reviewer territory, and the lead notes the server re-checks tokens.

F-027.reason: This is a typing-quality nit that I did not verify.

F-028.reason: router/index.ts:19-146 defines no catch-all route (no pathMatch), so an unknown URL has no fallback.

F-029.reason: The backend enforces roles, so client gating is UX only. Operator views being open to the user role is by design.

F-030.reason: router/index.ts:158-163 checks /api/setup only on the home route and swallows errors. Other entry URLs bypass the redirect to /init. This is a LOW issue.

F-031.reason: Form accessibility linkage is outside my scope.
